lines.zh: 飘飘忽忽，我顺着灰烬往下滑。
lines.en: Drifting, I slide down along the ash.

lines.zh: 我身体很轻，风一吹就歪。
lines.en: I'm so light a gust tips me off course.
My empty gut swings and knocks.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，一边飘一边找。
lines.en: Mouth open, I drift and hunt.

lines.zh: 灰烬森林很大，我飘得很慢。
lines.en: The ash forest is big; I drift slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕开骨堆，那味道太旧。
lines.en: I skirt the bone heap; the smell's too old.

lines.zh: 三条触手垂着，晃来晃去。
lines.en: My three tendrils hang and sway.

lines.zh: 我朝着有动静的地方去。
lines.en: I head where there's movement.

lines.zh: 我升了一点，绕过高处的石头。
lines.en: I rise a little to clear a high rock.
I drop back and drift near the ground.
I follow the thicker smoke.
My gut growls again.
I hover as my gut swells and shrinks.
My mouth is open, and there's nothing.
Firelight plays over my skin.

lines.zh: 我的触手垂着，一点力气也没有。
lines.en: My tendrils hang with no strength.
I'm listening for something chewing.
I swallow a mouthful of nothing.
Lava crackles far off.
I'm not satisfied at all.
You look good enough to eat.
My mouth is bigger than your head.

lines.zh: 你是这林子里最香的东西。
lines.en: You're the tastiest thing in this wood.
No hurry; my nostrils are flaring.

lines.zh: 你往后退了半步，我看见了。
lines.en: You stepped back; I saw.

lines.zh: 我的一条触手伸出来了。
lines.en: One of my tendrils has reached out.
My head tilts, mouth still open.
You look... delicious.
You knocked me crooked.
My gut deflates a bit.
That genuinely hurt.
I back off with my mouth still open.
My tendrils have pulled back.
I lick the spot that was hit.
I drift lower.
And I still want to eat you.
A smell — strong.

lines.zh: 我整个人都朝那边偏了。
lines.en: My whole body leans that way.
Give it to me; I'm starving.

lines.zh: 这一点塞不满我一颗牙。
lines.en: That won't fill one of my teeth.
I put my tongue out and lick it.

lines.zh: 还没吃到，我已经在嚼了。
lines.en: I'm chewing already and haven't had a bite.
Don't pull it back!
I come in slow so you don't bolt.
The smell just makes me hungrier.
More — I'm not full.

lines.zh: 你撞进我身体里，有点粘。
lines.en: You bump into me — I'm a bit sticky.
That set my gut rumbling.
I back off a little in case you hit me.
One of my tendrils brushed you.
You knocked me off balance.
That only made me hungrier.
Being this close is awkward.
I drift slowly around you.

lines.zh: 另一团灰白的东西飘过来。
lines.en: Another pale grey lump floats over.
Our bellies press together.
Two empty guts rumble together.

lines.zh: 我们一起往更热的地方去。
lines.en: We drift toward the hotter air together.
It opens its mouth; so do I.

lines.zh: 灰烬落在我们两个身上。
lines.en: Ash falls on both of us.
We don't speak; we just drift.
It left first; I followed a while.

lines.zh: 这一片林子够我们找吃的。
lines.en: This wood is big enough for us both.

lines.zh: 我把那块东西吸进嘴里。
lines.en: I draw the thing into my mouth.
Too hot; I spat it out.

lines.zh: 我的触手卷起一块骨头。
lines.en: My tendril curls around a bone.
I swallowed it and felt nothing.
This stone has no taste.
I roll it around my mouth.
I suck up a puff of ash and spit it out.
Too hard for my teeth.
This thing still carries a smell.
My gut wants to keep it.
There's movement over there.
I open my mouth wider.
I float over slowly, lightly.

lines.zh: 我的肚子已经开始响了。
lines.en: My gut has already started up.

lines.zh: 那东西在动，很好吃的样子。
lines.en: It's moving; looks tasty.
I've picked its throat.
It hasn't seen me.
Another foot closer.
I reach out a tendril to test.
It's panting; I hear it clearly.
I can barely keep my mouth shut.
This bite goes all the way down.
I drift low through the ash, following it.
It goes left; I swing left.

lines.zh: 我故意慢一点，让它放心。
lines.en: I slow a little so it relaxes.
Its footsteps come one by one.

lines.zh: 我的触手已经伸到前面了。
lines.en: My tendril is already reaching ahead.
I drift slowly down behind it.
At this range my mouth reaches.
It's started to run.
I speed up and the ash swirls.
I herd it toward the lava.
Its breathing gets more ragged.
Almost within reach.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，整个吞了。
lines.en: I bite down and swallow whole.
My mouth closes with a muffled sound.
A tendril curls and drags it in.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，肚子把它顶开。
lines.en: I ram it with my gut.

lines.zh: 这一口我连骨头都没吐。
lines.en: I didn't even spit the bones out.

lines.zh: 它挣了一下，就滑进我胃里。
lines.en: It struggled once, then slid down.
I belch.
I lick the ash from my lips.
And I'm still hungry.
I open my mouth again.
That one had no taste.
My mouth closes more slowly now.
It hit my teeth and slid off.
I turn with it a full circle.
I float up out of the ash.
My first breath is all ash.
My gut is still empty.
Burnt trees all around.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，先试了试空气。
lines.en: Mouth open, I test the air.
I turn a full circle slowly.
Hot wind rises from below.
My tendrils trail on the ground.
Ash settles on my back.
Something's walking far off.
I start drifting that way.
My gut growls loudly.

lines.zh: 火把我点着了，我慌得直转。
lines.en: Fire catches me and I spin in panic.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下去，肚子都翻了。
lines.en: I drop from a height and my gut turns over.

lines.zh: 水灌满我的嘴，我吞不下去。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I can't swallow it.
The blast puffs me out like a sack.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进了我的肚子。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my gut.
I'm so hungry I can't even drift straight.

lines.zh: 雷打透了我，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning goes right through me and I go numb.

lines.zh: 灰烬没了，坠得比落石还快。
lines.en: The ash is gone; I drop faster than falling stone.
